description: Count tokens and estimate the cost of a prompt/text across multiple LLM models (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Llama, Grok, and more). OpenAI token counts are exact (tiktoken); other providers are approximations and are flagged. Returns a Markdown comparison table plus structured JSON.

models.description: Model keys to compare (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet, gemini-2.5-pro). Omit for a sensible default set. Call list_models to see all keys.

outputTokens.description: Assumed output/completion tokens used for the total cost (default 500).

text.description: The prompt or text to measure.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate LLM cost
